```{r}
# ============================================================
# 📌 Phase 1 — 模型評估與資料視覺化
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) 匯入最新 R2_CV（cross-validation）數據
#--------------------------------------------------------------
df_cv <- read_csv("R2_CV.csv")

# 借車量的 CV R²
df_cv_borrow <- df_cv %>% filter(target == "borrow_count")

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) 匯入 12 月預測結果（真正 OOS）
#--------------------------------------------------------------
df_dec <- read_csv("R2_m12.csv")

df_dec_borrow <- df_dec %>% filter(target == "borrow_count")

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) R² vs 平均借車量（預測力與 demand 的關係）
#--------------------------------------------------------------
df_flow <- read_csv("df_merged.csv")

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) 預測 vs 實際散佈圖（12 月）
#--------------------------------------------------------------

library(ggrepel)

# 先定義最佳/最差站（用絕對誤差）
df_m12_target <- df_m12_target %>%
  mutate(err = abs(borrow_pred - borrow_count))

best  <- df_m12_target %>% arrange(err) %>% slice(1:30)
worst <- df_m12_target %>% arrange(desc(err)) %>% slice(1:30)

p <- ggplot(df_m12_target, aes(x = borrow_count, y = borrow_pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.2, color = "#2C7BB6") +  # 原始點

  # 完美線
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange") +

  # 標示最佳/最差
  geom_point(data = best, aes(x = borrow_count, y = borrow_pred),
             color = "green3", size = 3) +
  geom_label_repel(
      data = best,
      aes(label = station, x = borrow_count, y = borrow_pred),
      color = "green3", size = 3, box.padding = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_point(data = worst, aes(x = borrow_count, y = borrow_pred),
             color = "red3", size = 3) +
  geom_label_repel(
      data = worst,
      aes(label = station, x = borrow_count, y = borrow_pred),
      color = "red3", size = 3, box.padding = 0.3
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs Actual (Borrow Count, 12月)",
    x = "Actual Borrow Count",
    y = "Predicted Borrow Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)


# 儲存圖片
ggsave("fig_pred_vs_actual_borrow.png", p,
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# ----------- 圖存在 plot variable 裡面 -----------


# 讀檔
library(ggrepel)

df_cv <- read_csv("R2_CV.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count") %>%
  select(station, R2_cv = R2)

df_oos <- read_csv("R2_m12.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count") %>%
  select(station, R2_oos = R2_12m)

df_join <- inner_join(df_cv, df_oos, by = "station")

# Top & Bottom 站點
df_label2 <- df_join %>%
  arrange(desc(R2_oos)) %>%
  slice(c(1:5, (n()-4):n()))

p <- ggplot(df_join, aes(x = R2_cv, y = R2_oos)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.5, color = "#5A3E85") +

  geom_point(data = df_label2, 
             aes(x = R2_cv, y = R2_oos),
             color = "red", size = 3) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_label2,
    aes(label = station),
    color = "red",
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +

  labs(
    title = "CV R² vs OOS R²（標示預測最佳/最差站）",
    x = "Cross-Validation R²（9–11 月）",
    y = "OOS R²（12 月預測）"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

ggsave(
  filename = "cv_vs_oos_R2.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

# ----------- 圖存在 plot variable 裡面 -----------

library(ggrepel)

df_cap <- read_csv("df_merged.csv") %>%
  select(station, total) %>% distinct()

df_r2_cap <- df_oos %>%
  left_join(df_cap, by = "station") %>%
  distinct()

df_label3 <- df_r2_cap %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice(c(1:3)) %>%       # capacity 最大站
  bind_rows(
    df_r2_cap %>% 
      arrange(R2_oos) %>% 
      slice(1:3)          # 表現最差站
  )

p <- ggplot(df_r2_cap, aes(x = total, y = R2_oos)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, color = "#2A5783") +

  geom_point(data = df_label3,
             aes(x = total, y = R2_oos),
             color = "red", size = 3) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_label3,
    aes(label = station),
    color = "red", size = 3
  ) +

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  
  labs(
    title = "OOS R² vs Capacity（標示容量最大/預測最差站）",
    x = "Station Capacity (total)",
    y = "OOS R² (12 月預測)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)


# 若你想直接存圖
ggsave("R2_vs_capacity.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# 讀取 12 月預測 R2
df_oos <- read_csv("R2_m12.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count") %>%
  select(station, R2_oos = R2_12m)

# 讀平均借車量
df_avg <- read_csv("df_merged.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(avg_borrow = mean(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE))

# 合併
df_join <- df_oos %>% inner_join(df_avg, by = "station")

# 找前 5 和後 5
top5  <- df_join %>% arrange(desc(R2_oos)) %>% slice(1:5)
bottom5 <- df_join %>% arrange(R2_oos) %>% slice(1:5)

# 畫圖
p <- ggplot(df_join, aes(x = avg_borrow, y = R2_oos)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, color = "#5A3E85") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +

  # 標示預測最好的站：綠色
  geom_point(data = top5, aes(x = avg_borrow, y = R2_oos), 
             color = "red3", size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = top5, 
            aes(label = station), 
            color = "red3", nudge_y = 0.02, size = 3.5) +

  # 標示預測最差的站：紅色
  geom_point(data = bottom5, aes(x = avg_borrow, y = R2_oos), 
             color = "red3", size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = bottom5, 
            aes(label = station), 
            color = "red3", nudge_y = -0.02, size = 3.5) +

  labs(
    title = "OOS R² vs 平均借車量（標示預測最佳/最差站）",
    x = "平均借車量",
    y = "OOS R²（12 月預測）"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

ggsave("R2_vs_avg_borrow_annotated.png", p,
       width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
print(p)

```
